Cowboys were part of the Western theme. It featured Cowboys, Bandits and Cavalry. It was first released in 1996, and discontinued in 1997, however it was brought back in 2002 and carried on until 2004.

page.overview:
What is Cowboys?

Cowboys were part of the Western theme. It featured Cowboys, Bandits and Cavalry. It was first released in 1996, and discontinued in 1997, however it was brought back in 2002 and carried on until 2004.
